name: Sparrow and Dragon
description: Mahjong lessons, strategy classes, guided open play, leagues and private events around Greensboro and the Triad (some sessions in Summerfield). Site says a "National MahJongg League Card" is a complimentary benefit for those completing the three-part lesson series.
schedule: Events at Cuban Social House (Greensboro), Martin's Mercantile (Summerfield) and other venues; see calendar

name: Temple Emanuel Mah Jongg
description: Temple Emanuel hosts mah jongg open play on the 1st and 3rd Wednesday of each month and an annual tournament. Tournament page: "a National Mah Jongg League (NMJL) rule driven tournament" (bring a 2026 NMJL card).
address: Temple Emanuel, 1129 Jefferson Rd, Greensboro, NC 27410
schedule: 1st and 3rd Wednesday of each month 6:30-8:30 PM (open play); reserve a spot online
